name: Aniam
overview: Aniam is a male figure from the tribe of Manasseh, known specifically as the son of Shemida. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, situating him within the lineage of Manasseh as recorded in 1 Chronicles 7:19. There are no additional notes or details about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Aniam means 'I am kinsman,' reflecting a proper name of Hebrew origin. This meaning does not appear to be given directly by God but serves as an identifier within the biblical genealogies.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Aniam as the son of Shemida, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family connections or relationships are noted in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Aniam's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Manasseh, contributing to the biblical account of Israel's tribal families. His mention underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving the lineage of His people, which is foundational for understanding the fulfillment of God's promises through the tribes of Israel.
